name: convener-visuals
description: The pinned render step and its image comparison, plus the production render (render-production.mjs) and the README screenshots (render-readme-shots.mjs, which has no script of its own here because tools/scripts/render_readme_shots.py runs it inside a build of the example instance) on the same pinned engine -- puppeteer (full, bundled Chromium) is isolated to this package on purpose, so only this package's own CI jobs pay for the Chrome-for-Testing download; see .github/workflows/visuals.yml, .github/workflows/visuals-production.yml and each script's own module comment for the full reasoning.
